name: raftkit
description: RaftLabs' private plugin marketplace — the RaftLabs way of shipping software, packaged for Claude Code and Claude apps.

plugins.name: raftkit-core
plugins.description: RaftKit rules (Asana constants, the one human stop per run, fetch-once live reads, Asana HTML, free tier, scope line, escalation, readiness, plain output), the RaftLabs working agreement and Module Design Standard, and usage and token telemetry hooks.

plugins.name: raftkit-pm
plugins.description: PM skills: the Project Profile (from sources or a client call), one story skill (author, amend, check), estimation of a feature list or one story, and the weekly client update — each with one stop before any write.

plugins.name: raftkit-dev
plugins.description: Developer skills: repo setup, story implementation, bug and incident fixes, scope audit, UI, and docs parity — one stop per run.

plugins.name: raftkit-qa
plugins.description: QA skills: per-story test cases in a QA-owned Sheet with a manual run sheet, and one bug skill that files from Jam evidence and retests fixes — each with one stop before any write.

plugins.name: raftkit-docs
plugins.description: Opt-in documentation product: the co-authoring design flow and its interview, 9 adaptable templates, diagrams, reverse-engineering, scaffolding, and the project-local docs companion. Parity checks on a story stay in raftkit-dev.

plugins.name: raftkit-hasura
plugins.description: Opt-in Hasura skill for developers on Hasura projects: race-safe migrations with metadata and permissions, the project's own Make targets, stage queries — never edits an applied migration.
